beats.label: S1 · The Maple King
beats.text: The bomb at the Andrews house sends the gang into Rivervale, a wholesome-seeming Riverdale where Cheryl leads the town in sacrificing Archie as Maple King.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Rivervale as a distinct, hostile parallel where none of the show's rules apply.

beats.label: S1 · Souls for Sale
beats.text: Rivervale keeps spawning old horrors: La Llorona takes Toni's soul to save Anthony, the devil takes Reggie's, and Sabrina helps Cheryl channel her Blossom ancestors.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Anthology stakes explain the season's episodic supernatural pattern and set up Cheryl's growing power.

beats.label: S1 · Two Riverdales
beats.text: Jughead finds comics chronicling a parallel Riverdale and briefly seals the two worlds apart, learning the explosion cracked reality itself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mythology reveal that everything since the bomb has been a fork, which anchors the finale.

beats.label: S1 · Powers Awaken
beats.text: The bomb leaves them changed: Archie invulnerable, Betty senses evil, Jughead reads minds, Cheryl burns with pyrokinesis, Tabitha moves through time.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The powers are the toolkit the gang will use against Percival and must be introduced clearly.

beats.label: S1 · Percival Arrives
beats.text: Percival Pickens buys up the town, banishes the homeless, and drives the Ghoulies to mass suicide; investigators can find no record of him existing before Riverdale.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the primary antagonist and establishes his unnatural origin.

beats.label: S1 · Tabitha's Warning
beats.text: Tabitha's time-jumps expose Percival's plan to raze Pop's for a railroad and to turn Riverdale toward disaster; she urges the gang to strike back before he consolidates.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names Percival as an existential threat and marks Tabitha as the one who can see what's coming.

beats.label: S1 · Mayor Percival
beats.text: Percival is elected mayor and dissolves the council, tormenting the gang with cursed library books; they burn the items to break free but he still rules Rivervale.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season ends with Percival's grip intact, framing the ongoing power struggle.

cliffhanger.text: Percival Pickens is Rivervale's new mayor after dissolving the council. The gang broke his book curse but he still runs the town, and Reggie has crossed to his side.
questions: Can the gang topple a mayor whose real power isn't political?
Whose side is Reggie truly on now?
Are their new powers enough to match whatever Percival really is?

characters.name: Archie Andrews
characters.line: Town hero made invulnerable by the explosion, dating Betty and refusing to sell Riverdale out to Percival.

characters.name: Betty Cooper
characters.line: Senses malice around her, dating Archie, working with the FBI to build a case against Percival.

characters.name: Jughead Jones
characters.line: Telepathic writer investigating Percival's mysterious origins.

characters.name: Veronica Lodge
characters.line: Broke off with Reggie, runs a casino, battling family curses of her own.

characters.name: Cheryl Blossom
characters.line: Pyrokinetic matriarch of Thornhill, still grieving her lost love Heather.

characters.name: Toni Topaz
characters.line: Serpent leader ousted from the town council, fighting to keep custody of Anthony.

characters.name: Tabitha Tate
characters.line: Pop's owner and time-traveler who has seen a coming disaster for the town.

characters.name: Percival Pickens
characters.line: Rivervale's new mayor, an ageless newcomer with mind-control powers and no known past.

characters.name: Reggie Mantle
characters.line: Turned on the gang, kissed Kevin, and now openly aligned with Percival.

beats.label: S2 · Wrong 1955
beats.text: The gang wakes into a 1955 Riverdale with rearranged lives; only Jughead recalls the original timeline after digging up his high school time capsule.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's alt-reality premise and marks Jughead as the lone witness.

beats.label: S2 · The Milkman
beats.text: A Milkman starts killing across town, framing Ethel and Jughead; Julian's alibi frees them but the killings continue as Jughead keeps writing horror comics.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's central mystery, and the reason the Blossoms are eventually exposed.

beats.label: S2 · Forbidden
beats.text: Betty and Archie fall for each other despite dating Kevin and Cheryl, defying Alice's pageant, Cheryl's proxy engagement, and Cooper family control.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The romance that anchors the alt-reality half of the season and its emotional stakes.

beats.label: S2 · Russians at Thornhill
beats.text: Cheryl finds her Blossom parents are Russian spies making bombs from milkman uniforms and reports them to the FBI; Ethel is revealed as Hal's daughter and leaves town.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ties the Milkman thread to the Blossoms and clears the alt-reality mystery.

beats.label: S2 · Restored Memories
beats.text: Tabitha returns and restores the gang's memories, but the future is secure only if they stay: they live out their lives in the 1955 timeline.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mechanism that switches the season from 1955 back to Riverdale proper.

beats.label: S2 · Hal Unmasked
beats.text: Back in Riverdale: Fangs' shooter is exposed as Midge's mother, Hal is unmasked as the Black Hood, but a second hooded gunman shoots Fred at a rally.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the Black Hood identity while immediately opening a new copycat threat.

beats.label: S2 · Archie Framed
beats.text: Ghoulies attack Pop's and nearly kill Jughead; F.P. retires, Jughead becomes Serpent King, Hermione wins mayor, and Hiram frames Archie for murder at his inauguration.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every element of the next season's opening — Archie's trial, Jughead's crown, Hermione's office, Hiram's grip.

cliffhanger.text: Archie has been arrested for a murder Hiram engineered, moments after being sworn in as student body president. Hiram is consolidating criminal control of the whole Southside with Penelope, Penny Peabody, Malachi, and Sheriff Minetta.
questions: Can Archie beat a murder charge Hiram controls half the law on?
What is Hiram actually building on the Southside?
What kind of Serpent King will Jughead be with Hiram closing in?

characters.name: Archie Andrews
characters.line: Arrested for murder at his own student body inauguration, framed by Hiram.

characters.name: Betty Cooper
characters.line: Just exposed her own father as the Black Hood and had him arrested.

characters.name: Jughead Jones
characters.line: Newly crowned Serpent King after F.P.'s retirement, having survived a Ghoulie ambush.

characters.name: Veronica Lodge
characters.line: Traded the Whyte Wyrm to her father for Pop's, now openly against him.

characters.name: Hiram Lodge
characters.line: Consolidating criminal power over the Southside, engineered Archie's frame.

characters.name: Hermione Lodge
characters.line: Newly elected mayor of Riverdale, still Hiram's political partner.

characters.name: F.P. Jones
characters.line: Retired from the Serpents and passed leadership to Jughead.

characters.name: Cheryl Blossom
characters.line: Joined the Serpents alongside Toni after fleeing the Blossom estate.

beats.label: S3 · The Trial
beats.text: Archie's trial ends in a hung jury; a plea sends him to juvie, where Hiram controls the Warden and orchestrates violence against him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Grounds the season in Archie's imprisonment and Hiram's reach into the prison system.

beats.label: S3 · Gargoyle King
beats.text: Ethel introduces Jughead to a deadly board game, Gryphons & Gargoyles; the Gargoyle King stalks the town, and their parents played the same game as the Midnight Club.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's mystery and connects it to the parents' generation.

beats.label: S3 · Quarantine
beats.text: Betty infiltrates the Sisters of Quiet Mercy and exposes Hiram producing Fizzle Rocks there; Hiram retaliates by quarantining Riverdale off from the world.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Isolates the town and cements Hiram as the season's structural villain.

beats.label: S3 · The Hit on Hiram
beats.text: The Gargoyle King is unmasked as Tall Boy working for Hiram; Hiram is shot and F.P. becomes sheriff, but Hermione secretly ordered the hit.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the first Gargoyle King identity and reshuffles the parents' allegiances.

beats.label: S3 · Enter the Farm
beats.text: Alice, Polly, Kevin, Fangs, and Toni are drawn into Edgar Evernever's Farm cult, which offers them visions of dead loved ones.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's second antagonist thread that overtakes the finale.

beats.label: S3 · Organ Harvest
beats.text: Betty discovers the Farm is harvesting members' organs; Cheryl saves Toni before her surgery and the Serpents raid the compound to rescue Kevin.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns the Farm from spiritual threat to a physical rescue operation.

beats.label: S3 · Two Masterminds
beats.text: Penelope masterminded the game with Chic as Gargoyle King; she kills Hal and escapes. Alice was an FBI mole all along, handled by Charles — Betty's alive half-brother.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every reveal — Penelope, Chic, the FBI backchannel, Charles's existence — reshapes the next season's landscape.

cliffhanger.text: A flash-forward shows Archie, Betty, and Veronica in the woods, covered in blood, burning Jughead's beanie and vowing to split up so they never get caught. Penelope has escaped after killing Hal, and Charles Cooper has just introduced himself as Alice's FBI handler and Betty's half-brother.
questions: What have they done, or what has been done to Jughead?
Can four teenagers keep a secret through senior year?
Who is Charles Cooper really, and can Alice's newfound son be trusted?

characters.name: Archie Andrews
characters.line: Cleared of murder and back in Riverdale after prison, escape, and a boxing arc.

characters.name: Betty Cooper
characters.line: Broke the Farm and just learned Charles is her FBI half-brother.

characters.name: Jughead Jones
characters.line: Serpent King dating Betty, heading into senior year.

characters.name: Veronica Lodge
characters.line: Runs La Bonne Nuit.

characters.name: Cheryl Blossom
characters.line: Recovered Jason's body from Edgar and buried him properly at Thornhill.

characters.name: Hiram Lodge
characters.line: Arrested by the FBI at Archie's boxing match, his prison and drug empire in collapse.

characters.name: Alice Cooper
characters.line: Revealed as an undercover FBI informant; the Farm she pretended to join is broken.

characters.name: Charles Cooper
characters.line: FBI agent and Betty and Jughead's alive half-brother, ran the Farm operation from the inside.

characters.name: Kevin Keller
characters.line: Rescued from the Farm, still processing his time in Edgar's cult.

beats.label: S4 · Fred's Funeral
beats.text: Fred Andrews is killed by a hit-and-run driver; the town mourns and Archie tries to fill his father's shoes as protector of Riverdale.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fred's death drives Archie's community-center arc and his eventual army decision.

beats.label: S4 · Stonewall Prep
beats.text: Senior year begins under strict new principal Mr. Honey; Jughead transfers to elite Stonewall Prep and rooms with hostile Bret and a reconciled Moose.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the setting and antagonists of the season's main mystery.

beats.label: S4 · Edgar Falls
beats.text: Alice kills Edgar Evernever as he tries to ascend, freeing the last of the Farm members; videotapes of Riverdale houses start appearing on doorsteps.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the S3 threat cleanly and plants the season's other mystery in the same beat.

beats.label: S4 · Uncle Frank
beats.text: Uncle Frank returns after Dodger's arc ends and takes over Andrews Construction; his mercenary past resurfaces and forces him out of town.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Frank and closes his arc within the season while explaining his later resurfacing.

beats.label: S4 · The Ghostwriter Plot
beats.text: Jughead uncovers a Stonewall conspiracy: the Baxter Brothers ghostwriter is chosen by murder, orchestrated by Mr. DuPont and executed by Bret, Donna, and Joan.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mystery's engine, which the season's central twist runs on.

beats.label: S4 · Faked Death
beats.text: Jughead is bludgeoned in the woods; Betty, Archie, and Veronica burn his beanie and their clothes — but Jughead is secretly alive, hiding with Charles.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's structural twist, and the setup for the Betty-Archie affair fallout.

beats.label: S4 · Kill Mr. Honey
beats.text: The Stonewall plot collapses; DuPont kills himself. Betty and Archie kiss during the mourning but stop. A new masked video shows the gang stabbing Principal Honey to death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes Stonewall while opening the videotape auteur thread that spills into prom night.

cliffhanger.text: A videotape shows the gang in Riverdale masks stabbing Principal Honey to death, though they never touched him. The videotape auteur is still unknown, and Betty and Archie's stopped-at-the-line kiss hasn't gone away.
questions: Who is filming Riverdale and framing the gang?
Can Betty and Archie contain what they started at rehearsal?
Is Mr. Honey — fired but alive — actually a target?

characters.name: Archie Andrews
characters.line: Kissed Betty during Jughead's supposed death; still officially with Veronica.

characters.name: Betty Cooper
characters.line: FBI intern with Charles, back with Jughead but harbouring feelings for Archie.

characters.name: Jughead Jones
characters.line: Alive after faking his death, back at Riverdale High after exposing Stonewall.

characters.name: Veronica Lodge
characters.line: Knows about the Archie-Betty kiss and is working through it while running her rum business.

characters.name: Cheryl Blossom
characters.line: Freed of Julian's ghost, still at Thistlehouse with Toni.

characters.name: Hiram Lodge
characters.line: Released from prison, terminally ill, briefly mayor before losing office.

characters.name: Frank Andrews
characters.line: Archie's uncle, forced to leave town after his mercenary past caught up to him.

characters.name: Charles Cooper
characters.line: FBI agent who secretly harboured Jughead through the fake-death plot.

beats.label: S5 · Prom Falls Apart
beats.text: Prom night detonates the group: Betty confesses her feelings for Archie, Veronica walks out, the auteur mystery resolves, and the gang scatters after graduation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills the S4 status quo and sets up the seven-year gap.

beats.label: S5 · Seven Years Later
beats.text: Seven years pass: Archie returns from the army to a dying Riverdale under Hiram's control and calls Betty, Veronica, and Jughead back for a reunion.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes every character's new adult life and the reason they reassemble.

beats.label: S5 · Save the School
beats.text: The core four take teaching jobs to keep Riverdale High open against Hiram's plan to dissolve the town; Betty's sister Polly has been missing on the Lonely Highway.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Anchors the group's shared purpose and plants the Polly mystery that runs the season.

beats.label: S5 · Lonely Highway
beats.text: Betty is FBI, hunting a trucker serial killer preying on women; she captures one but suspects he isn't acting alone. Polly's blood turns up on a destroyed phone booth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's serial killer arc and its personal hook for Betty.

beats.label: S5 · Chad's End
beats.text: Jughead spirals through psychedelic mushrooms and NYC benders; Chad tries to kill Archie, fails, then attacks Veronica and she kills him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frees Veronica from her marriage and shows how each returned adult is unravelling.

beats.label: S5 · Polly Found
beats.text: Polly's killers are inbred Blossoms hiding in the forest, working with the captured trucker; Alice grieves as they bury Polly's ashes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the serial killer mystery and closes Polly's arc.

beats.label: S5 · The Bomb
beats.text: Betty and Archie reconcile, planning a real relationship. Hiram plants a bomb under Archie's bed and drives away as the house explodes in fire.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The cliffhanger the next season opens inside of.

cliffhanger.text: Hiram's bomb has just detonated under Archie's bed with Betty and Archie inside. Hiram drives out of Riverdale as the Andrews house lights up behind him.
questions: Did Betty and Archie survive the blast?
What is left of Riverdale now that Hiram has burnt his last bridge?
Where does anyone go from here?

characters.name: Archie Andrews
characters.line: Back from the army, reconciled with Betty, and his house has just been bombed.

characters.name: Betty Cooper
characters.line: FBI serial-killer specialist, back with Archie.

characters.name: Jughead Jones
characters.line: Sober again after his NYC spiral, dating Tabitha, teaching at Riverdale High.

characters.name: Veronica Lodge
characters.line: Divorced after killing Chad in self-defence, running her jewellery business.

characters.name: Cheryl Blossom
characters.line: Left the ministry, matriarch of Thornhill, took in Britta.

characters.name: Toni Topaz
characters.line: New mother to Anthony, joined the reincorporated town council.

characters.name: Tabitha Tate
characters.line: Pop's owner and Jughead's girlfriend, launching a Pop's franchise.

characters.name: Hiram Lodge
characters.line: Just bombed Archie's house and driven out of Riverdale.

characters.name: Reggie Mantle
characters.line: Back with Veronica, planning to open a casino.

characters.name: Kevin Keller
characters.line: Teacher at Riverdale High; broke off his engagement to Fangs.

beats.label: S6 · Wake in 1955
beats.text: The gang wakes into a 1955 alt-reality Riverdale with rearranged lives; only Jughead remembers, and everyone dismisses him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the alt-reality premise for most of the season.

beats.label: S6 · The Milkman
beats.text: A Milkman kills Ethel's parents and starts a spree; Jughead investigates through his censored horror comics as the killings keep coming.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The 1955 timeline's central mystery that eventually implicates the Blossoms.

beats.label: S6 · Forbidden
beats.text: Betty and Archie fall for each other while dating Kevin and Cheryl; Cheryl breaks off with Archie to pursue Toni instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The romance carrying the alt-reality half of the season.

beats.label: S6 · Blossom Spies
beats.text: Cheryl discovers her Blossom parents are Russian spies making bombs from milkman uniforms; the Milkman victims all trace back to them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ties the Milkman mystery to the Blossoms and clears the alt-reality case.

beats.label: S6 · Sweet Hereafter
beats.text: Tabitha restores their memories, and an aged Betty in the present dies and joins her teenage friends in the afterlife at Pop's.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Bridges the 1955 arc into the Rivervale finale and closes an emotional through-line.

beats.label: S6 · Killing Percival
beats.text: Back in Rivervale, the gang finally moves on Percival: they trap him in his own mind and drag him into Rivervale's Pop's, where his own counterparts stab him to death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the Percival threat that has run since the very first season.

beats.label: S6 · Melting the Comet
beats.text: Percival's dying spell hurls Bailey's Comet at Riverdale; Cheryl absorbs the gang's powers and melts it, and everyone wakes in 1955 with only Jughead remembering.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mechanism that launches the next season's setting.

cliffhanger.text: The gang is stranded in a 1955 alt-reality Riverdale with entirely different lives. Only Jughead remembers who they really are, and nobody believes him.
questions: Can the gang ever be pulled back to their real lives, and by whom?
What happens when your teenage self starts making choices you never made?
Is Riverdale safe now that Percival is dead and the comet is gone?

characters.name: Archie Andrews
characters.line: Now living in 1955, forbidden from driving after James Dean's death, chasing Veronica.

characters.name: Betty Cooper
characters.line: In 1955, dating Kevin, with no memory of her real life.

characters.name: Jughead Jones
characters.line: The only one who remembers the real timeline; lives alone in 1955.

characters.name: Veronica Lodge
characters.line: 1955 socialite exiled to Riverdale over her role in James Dean's accident.

characters.name: Cheryl Blossom
characters.line: In 1955 at Thornhill with her twin brother Julian alive again.

characters.name: Toni Topaz
characters.line: In a secret 1955 relationship with Cheryl, covering Emmett Till's murder with Betty.

characters.name: Tabitha Tate
characters.line: Original-timeline time-traveler who erased Jughead's memory to protect the past.

characters.name: Percival Pickens
characters.line: Killed in Rivervale's Pop's, but diverted Bailey's Comet with his dying spell.

beats.label: S7 · Awake in 1955
beats.text: Only Jughead recalls the original timeline; a buried time capsule confirms it but everyone dismisses him as Riverdale settles into its 1955 shape.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The starting condition of the season and Jughead's isolated vantage.

beats.label: S7 · The Milkman
beats.text: A Milkman kills Ethel's parents and starts a spree; Jughead investigates while writing censored horror comics under Dr. Werthers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's central mystery that quietly points at the Blossoms.

beats.label: S7 · Forbidden Loves
beats.text: Betty and Archie fall for each other despite dating Kevin and Cheryl; Cheryl and Toni build a real relationship parallel to Kevin's coming out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The emotional through-line of the alt-reality year.

beats.label: S7 · Blossom Spies
beats.text: Jughead traces the Milkman victims to the Blossoms; Cheryl finds her parents are Russian spies making bombs and reports them to the FBI.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the Milkman mystery and closes the Blossom parents' arc.

beats.label: S7 · Ethel Is Hal's
beats.text: Betty discovers Ethel is Hal's biological daughter through an affair; Ethel chooses to leave Riverdale rather than become a Cooper.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes Ethel out of the story and reshapes what Betty knows about her family.

beats.label: S7 · Real Memories
beats.text: Tabitha returns from her timeline mission and offers to restore the gang's memories; they choose to remember, including the bad parts.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment they consciously accept their real lives before the finale.

beats.label: S7 · Sweet Hereafter
beats.text: An aged Betty visits Riverdale one last time, dies outside a shuttered Pop's, and joins her teenage friends — young again — in the Sweet Hereafter.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's closing image and final statement.

cliffhanger.text: The series closes with Betty stepping into the Sweet Hereafter Pop's, where her lost friends wait for her, forever teenagers. Their real lives are over; the story is complete.
questions: Was any of this real, or Jughead's story from the beginning?
What lives did they actually live after 1955?
Is Pop's really the afterlife every Riverdale kid gets?

characters.name: Betty Cooper
characters.line: Died in the present as an old woman; now teenaged in the afterlife Pop's.

characters.name: Archie Andrews
characters.line: Waits with Jughead and Veronica in the Sweet Hereafter booth.

characters.name: Jughead Jones
characters.line: Appears as an apparition to guide Betty home; his voice gives closure to the series.

characters.name: Veronica Lodge
characters.line: Reunites with the gang in the afterlife Pop's.

characters.name: Cheryl Blossom
characters.line: Publicly with Toni after their 1955 relationship comes out.

characters.name: Toni Topaz
characters.line: In an open relationship with Cheryl by the end of the 1955 arc.

characters.name: Tabitha Tate
characters.line: Chose to preserve the timeline and restored the gang's memories one final time.
